routes.name: Visa-free entry
routes.summary: Citizens of many countries (the official list has 166 entries, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia and most of the EU) don't need a visa. Visitors get 90 days in any 12-month period.

other: See the official list of nationals who do not require a visa.
Air arrivals need a return ticket. Land and water arrivals need enough funds for the stay and departure.
The list page carries a 2019 copyright date, and a December 2024 news item mentions a waiver for 53 countries, so the list may be out of date. Confirm with the Department.

stay.note: Free extensions can be requested at the nearest immigration office.

sources.label: Zambia Immigration: Nationals who do not require a visa

routes.name: Tourist visa (eVisa or on arrival)
routes.summary: If you need a visa, you can apply through the Zambia eVisa portal or get one on arrival. Single, double and multiple entry options exist. Visas are valid for 90 days from first issue.

other: Passport valid at least 6 months with 3 blank pages.
Host details and a physical address for your whole stay.
Return ticket for air arrivals. Enough funds for land or water arrivals.
Under 16s must be included in an adult's application.

Fees conflict between pages: the visitors page lists single entry at USD 25 and multiple at USD 75, the fees page lists single entry at USD 50. Fees were revised in August 2024. Confirm on the eServices portal.

steps: Register an account on the Zambia eVisa portal.
Pay by credit or debit card.
Download your approval letter and receipt and bring them when you travel.

fees.label: Day tripper (Victoria Falls and Kazungula only)

routes.name: Transit visa (overland)
routes.summary: Needed if you must have a visa and cross Zambia by land. It's valid for up to 7 days. You don't need one if you transit directly by air or stay within the airport.

other: Applies to nationals who need a visa and travel through Zambia by land.

sources.label: Zambia Immigration: Visa requirements by purpose of visit

routes.name: Temporary Employment Permit (business visitors over 30 days)
routes.summary: For business visitors who need to stay more than 30 days. Total stay can't exceed 6 months in any 12-month period.

other: Covering letter from the business partner, Form 25, passport copy and photo.

routes.name: Visiting Permit
routes.summary: For ordinary visitors staying more than 90 days. Valid 3 months at a time, up to 9 months in any 12-month period. You need a Zambian host.

other: Covering letter, host's consent letter and proof of host's status, passport copy, photo, return ticket or proof you can return.

stay.note: Can't extend beyond 9 months within any 12-month period.

routes.name: Employment Permit
routes.summary: For jobs longer than six months with a company, government body, NGO or religious organization. Extendable up to a maximum of 10 years. You wait outside Zambia until approved.

other: Employer's covering letter, contract or offer, police clearance, CV, qualifications.
A succession plan with an understudy program and newspaper advertisements for the job.
Only an employer, practising lawyer or immigration consultant can apply.
Holders can't buy land or study at Zambian institutions.

stay.note: Over 6 months, extendable to a maximum of 10 years in total.

routes.name: Investor's Permit
routes.summary: For people who start, invest in or join a business in Zambia. The minimum is USD 250,000 for a new business and USD 150,000 to join an existing one.

investment.note: USD 150,000 to join an existing company

other: Certificate of incorporation, minimum capital certificate, list of directors, proof of personal investment, proof of premises.
Permit length was not stated on the page.

routes.name: Spouse Permit
routes.summary: For spouses of Zambian citizens, established residents and residence permit holders.

other: Covering letter, spouse's consent letter, proof of the sponsor's status, marriage certificate, passport copy, photo, proof of sustenance.
Permit length was not stated on the page.

routes.name: Study Permit
routes.summary: For full-time or part-time study at a Zambian institution. Dependants studying over three months also need one.

other: Covering letter, passport copy, acceptance letter, medical report from a Zambian government facility, sponsor's letter and financial status.
Holders can't work for gain beyond what the permit allows.
Permit length was not stated on the page.

routes.name: Residence Permit (permanent)
routes.summary: Permanent residence for long-term holders: employment permit holders (10+ years), investor's permit holders (3+ years), spouse permit holders (5+ years), and retirees. It lapses if you don't enter within 6 months of issue, or are away over 12 months.

other: Requirements vary by category. Retirees show proof of funds and a pension.
Covering letter, passport copy, birth or marriage certificate, photos.

routes.name: Asylum Seeker's Permit
routes.summary: A 30-day permit for people seeking asylum, to allow time for refugee status determination.

other: National Registration Card and passport, if available.
